tuple_convention: ordered permutations of 0..d-1, positive generators; root is 0
target: Replace sum (d!)^r by sum a_r(d), where a_r(d) counts index-d subgroups of the free group of rank r; only an upper bound for arbitrary r-generated groups.
geometric_assumptions: N distinct geometric images of primitive closed geodesics
each has a closed embedded lift to a connected cover of degree at most D
metric on each cover is pulled back; one cover is selected up to isomorphism over the base
limits: No assertion that the required uniformly bounded simple lifts exist, or that simplicity descends to the base.
